visual_brief: 伊斯坦布尔阿塔图尔克奥林匹克体育场：不对称设计，西侧主看台上方一道巨大的新月形悬挑顶棚，其余看台为露天大碗并有跑道；2005、2023 欧冠决赛场。易混淆：加拉塔萨雷 RAMS Park、费内巴切主场、其他城市同名 Atatürk Stadium。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。试过 Flickr 可商用许可（CC BY/BY-SA/CC0/PDM/US Gov）文字检索：ataturk olympic stadium、atatürk olimpiyat stadı、olimpiyat stadyumu、istanbul olympic stadium、ataturk stadium istanbul、champions league final istanbul、ikitelli stadium，以及标签 ataturkolympicstadium 等，均无该球场照片；网页检索只见 Getty/Alamy（不可用）和维基共享资源（按规则不可用）；Pixabay 免费版仅 1280 像素，Unsplash/Pexels 在本环境无法访问。理想画面：Aerial late-afternoon view of Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Başakşehir, Istanbul: a huge oval open bowl with a running track, a single giant white crescent-shaped cantilever roof floating over the west main stand only, the rest of the stands open to the sky, packed with fans for a European final, warm golden light, clear sky, suburban Istanbul around; do not show roofs on other stands, no masts, not RAMS Park or Fenerbahçe's Şükrü Saracoğlu. 裁后高按卡片宽高比 720/800=0.9 用 python 计算：w/h≥0.9 时取 h，否则取 w/0.9，见各候选 crop_h。
